completion_target.completion_condition: No additional second-class-applicable explicit answer-defining proposition in the authoritative source survives full-canonical pre-screen and independent review.

authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use second-class-applicable material only; exclude subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕.

prohibited_expansion: scenario-only variation when the answer-defining proposition is already represented
threshold/boundary variation when the answer-defining proposition is already represented
reasoning-path variation when the answer-defining proposition is already represented
controlled Tier B or Tier C variants used only to increase question count
unsupported inference beyond explicit source support
ambiguous or multiple defensible correct answers
incidental trivia with low exam/practice value
candidate created to satisfy any numeric quota

tier_policy.definition: A candidate is eligible only when its source-defined answer-defining proposition is not already represented in canonical inventory. Topic adjacency to existing questions is allowed only when the proposition itself is distinct.
tier_policy.b18_transition_rule: Re-review all six already-authored B18 candidates under this residual-proposition rule. B18-RULE-C003 may survive only if the explicit aircraft right-of-way concept and rationale are absent as an answer-defining proposition in canonical inventory; prior Tier-B labeling gives it no special allowance.

method: scan all second-class-applicable source sections for explicit propositions
compare each proposition against all canonical questions before authoring
author only propositions that are not already answer-defining
independently review each authored candidate under the same residual-only rule
Director accepts only surviving residual propositions
allocate IDs, integrate canonical drafts, and source-verify accepted questions
repeat until no eligible residual proposition remains
close Question Bank Completion without manufacturing a numeric target

preserved_invariants: Released/runtime remain 188 until an explicit release activation gate.
Existing question identities and release history remain unchanged.
The existing free selection remains unchanged until a separate monetization decision.
The immutable V0 100-question historical validation snapshot remains unchanged.
No HUMAN review identity is fabricated.
